title: 東都ベイ・ドライブ
caption: 1980s Japanese city pop, glossy and sophisticated. Clear, sweet female lead vocal in Japanese with soft backing harmonies. Funky slap bass, tight live drums with a gated reverb snare, bright Rhodes electric piano playing jazzy major seventh chords, clean chorus-effect rhythm guitar, punchy horn section stabs, shimmering analog synth pads, a smooth alto saxophone solo. Warm analog tape production. Breezy, romantic, a night drive along the bay.
